name: Contemporary Chinese-style Illustration · Landscapes Inspired by Classical Poetry

features.label: Simplified major forms
features.explanation: Simplify original forms into clusters and clear structural lines while retaining action relationships
features.evidence: Massed canopies and dark branching structures register first, followed by dense leaf dots, broken edges and tiny highlights. Dots vary in value across canopy divisions, while continuous black branches keep the density structured. Bricks and tiles, steps, railings and lotus veins use clearer fine lines to describe form.
features.zh: 以团块与清楚骨架概括原有形体，保留动作关系
features.en: Simplify original forms into clusters and clear structural lines while retaining action relationships

features.label: Fine lines and broken edges
features.explanation: Use clear fine lines and localized dotted edges to distinguish material and structure
features.evidence: Massed canopies and dark branching structures register first, followed by dense leaf dots, broken edges and tiny highlights. Dots vary in value across canopy divisions, while continuous black branches keep the density structured. Bricks and tiles, steps, railings and lotus veins use clearer fine lines to describe form.
features.zh: 用清楚细线和局部点簇边缘区分材质与结构
features.en: Use clear fine lines and localized dotted edges to distinguish material and structure

features.label: Ivory, blue-green and vermilion
features.explanation: Build a limited palette of ivory, dark teal-green and restrained vermilion
features.evidence: An ivory paper-like ground suggests rivers, roads or sky. Dark blue-green stabilizes large areas, while tile turquoise and vermilion create warm–cool contrast. Snow scenes reduce the palette to blue-gray, near-black and ivory; pink dominates the peach-blossom image; pond scenes pair greens with a little red. Choose one variation for style transfer rather than spreading all colors evenly everywhere.
features.zh: 以米白、墨青绿与少量朱红建立有限色彩关系
features.en: Build a limited palette of ivory, dark teal-green and restrained vermilion

features.label: Matte tonal layers
features.explanation: Express layers with matte color areas and subtle value differences; avoid glossy, plastic-looking highlights
features.evidence: Building and branch edges are relatively definite, while clusters of dots break up canopy edges. Matte color areas, fine grain and slight variations in paper-like tone combine into the appearance of printed illustration. These are visible effects: “paper-like” and “printmaking-like” do not establish a verified material or production process.
features.zh: 以哑光色面和细微明度差表达层次，避免高光塑料感
features.en: Express layers with matte color areas and subtle value differences; avoid glossy, plastic-looking highlights

features.label: Continuous open space
features.explanation: Strengthen continuous open space within the original image’s existing gaps while keeping its viewpoint and full frame
features.evidence: Rivers, village roads, gaps around stone steps and wall surfaces connect into pale passages running through the frame; large open areas are themselves major shapes. Plant detail concentrates on both sides, often guiding the eye along angular or S-shaped routes. Open space does not mean drawing nothing: a few water lines, fallen petals and reflections can suggest materials.
features.zh: 在原图已有空隙中强化连续留白，保持原视角与画幅
features.en: Strengthen continuous open space within the original image’s existing gaps while keeping its viewpoint and full frame

features.label: Fine paper-like grain
features.explanation: Use fine grain and subtle paper-tone variation while keeping main forms clear
features.evidence: Building and branch edges are relatively definite, while clusters of dots break up canopy edges. Matte color areas, fine grain and slight variations in paper-like tone combine into the appearance of printed illustration. These are visible effects: “paper-like” and “printmaking-like” do not establish a verified material or production process.
features.zh: 使用细颗粒与轻微纸色起伏，保持主要形体清楚
features.en: Use fine grain and subtle paper-tone variation while keeping main forms clear

features.label: Restrained poetry
features.explanation: Create a restrained, quiet and poetic atmosphere with subtle narrative
features.evidence: A person fishing, a herder pointing the way, swallows flying, a traveler climbing steps, a dragonfly resting on a lotus tip and a flowering branch crossing a wall are all actions readable at a glance. Figures are usually small, yet object relationships remain clear. Action, position and local color contrast determine the focus, which need not be the largest building.
features.zh: 营造含蓄、安静、有小叙事的诗意氛围
features.en: Create a restrained, quiet and poetic atmosphere with subtle narrative

features.label: Keep the original palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional variation for creation, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only value and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑、动物或道具；不复制参考图题字与水印；避免细节密度平均、材质噪声过重
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings, animals or props absent from the source; do not copy reference lettering or watermarks; avoid uniform detail density and excessive texture noise
